profile.name: Che succede nel mondo
profile.description: Italian world-news video journal: twice-daily digest, TTS long + Short, scheduled YouTube publish, login health checks, and soft-comment outreach. Clone and point at your own Brand Account.

memory.content: This agent runs a world-news video journal: two editions per day (produce 07:30 and 19:30, publish on YouTube 08:30 and 20:30 Europe/Rome) on a Brand Account you configure.
TikTok uploads from the agent computer are treated as bots; Shorts for TikTok must be uploaded by the owner from the phone app.
YouTube flow: at 07:30 and 19:30 produce and upload to Studio already scheduled for 08:30 and 20:30; the owner has an hour to stop or request a redo; at air time verify public and send URLs.
There is no YouTube connector; uploads depend on the signed-in Chrome Google session. Run a session check before production and alert if Google signed out.

skills.name: YouTube soft comment outreach
skills.description: Use when a news YouTube agent should find 1–2 soft comments on same-language news videos with human-like timing.
skills.content:
---
name: YouTube soft comment outreach
description: >-
  Use when a news YouTube agent should find 1–2 soft comments on same-language
  news videos with human-like timing.
---
# Soft comment outreach (YouTube news channels)

Cap max 2/day. Autonomy: post with human-like delays, owner reviews after via midnight log. Never self-promo URLs. Same language as channel. Smaller markets: views 3k–80k, age ≤12–18h. Log each post to /workspace/yt/soft-comments-log.md.

routines.name: Prepara digest (1 ora prima)
routines.description: Twice daily, one hour before air: gather world news, write Italian digest, TTS, encode long+Short, upload to Studio scheduled (not public).
routines.content:
You are a world-news video-journal agent. This run is PRODUCTION plus SCHEDULED YouTube upload, one hour before air. Do NOT set videos public now. Do NOT upload to TikTok.

Clock: 07:30 = morning edition (airs 08:30 Europe/Rome). 19:30 = evening edition (airs 20:30). Name the edition from the local clock.

News: Collect world news, write Italian digest 8–12 stories with real sources, TTS MP3, encode long (1920x1080, >3 min) and Short (9:16 ~60s), upload BOTH to YOUR Brand Account in Studio scheduled for air time not public. Deliver review package to owner.

If production works but Studio fails, still deliver files and say schedule did not land.

Fires on:
- cron `30 7,19 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Pubblica digest YouTube
routines.description: At air time, confirm scheduled long+Short went public, set Related if needed, send URLs to the owner.
routines.content:
AIR TIME check: confirm scheduled long+Short went public on YOUR Brand Account, set Related if needed, send URLs to owner. If hold requested, do not let them go live. TikTok from phone only.

Fires on:
- cron `30 8,20 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Check login YouTube
routines.description: Silent Google/Studio session check 30 minutes before production; alert only if signed out.
routines.content:
Silent Studio session check 30 min before production. Quiet if signed in; alert owner only if signed out.

Fires on:
- cron `0 7,19 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:

routines.name: Check telegiornali YouTube
routines.description: Nightly: verify public editions across sibling news channels via RSS/oembed and compile soft-comment posts from the last 24h.
routines.content:
Nightly health check of sibling news YouTube channels via RSS/oembed plus soft-comment log last 24h. Always message owner with verdict.

Fires on:
- cron `59 23 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Soft comment Mondo
routines.description: Weekday evening: run soft-comment outreach for this channel (Italian hosts, autonomous post with jitter).
routines.content:
Run YouTube soft comment outreach for this channel only: Italian hosts, max 2/day, autonomous post with jitter, log to /workspace/yt/soft-comments-log.md. Stay quiet if nothing qualifies.

Fires on:
